titulo.alumno:
«Каталог музея и описание предмета»
Museum catalogue and describing an object

intro: A museum record can include author, date, technique, provenance and condition; separate the metadata from the interpretation.

texto: A museum record can include author, date, technique, provenance and condition; separate the metadata from the interpretation.
Provenance indicates where the piece came from; it does not always equal who made it or who owned it.
